<section class="wm-faq" id="faqs">
  <div class="wm-faq__container">
    <h2 class="wm-faq__title">FAQs</h2>

    <div class="wm-faq__list">
      <div class="wm-faq__item wm-faq__item--active">
        <button class="wm-faq__trigger">
          <span class="wm-faq__question">What is Watermark Course Evaluations & Surveys (CE&S)?</span>
          <svg class="wm-faq__icon" viewbox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2"><path d="M6 9l6 6 6-6"></path></svg>
        </button>
        <div class="wm-faq__panel">
          <div class="wm-faq__content">
           <p>Watermark Course Evaluations & Surveys is a centralized platform for collecting, managing, and analyzing feedback from students and stakeholders about courses, instructors, and academic programs. It enables institutions to standardize evaluation processes and use feedback to improve teaching and learning.</p>
          </div>
        </div>
      </div>

      <div class="wm-faq__item">
        <button class="wm-faq__trigger">
          <span class="wm-faq__question">I already have a survey tool. What are the benefits of switching?</span>
          <svg class="wm-faq__icon" viewbox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2"><path d="M6 9l6 6 6-6"></path></svg>
        </button>
        <div class="wm-faq__panel">
          <div class="wm-faq__content">
            <p>More than 30 institutions made the switch from their prior vendor to Watermark Course Evaluations & Surveys in the last six months alone. This year, a dozen switched from Blackboard (formerly Anthology), half a dozen from Explorance, and more than half a dozen from Scantron — plus a dozen institutions that moved from generic survey tools to a platform built specifically for student feedback. We make switching seamless, and our work is backed by numerous awards, including the 2026 EdTech Breakthrough Award for Best Course Evaluation Solution. <a href="https://www.watermarkinsights.com/resources/flyer/what-sets-course-evaluations-and-surveys-apart/">See what sets us apart.</a></p>
          </div>
        </div>
      </div>

      <div class="wm-faq__item">
        <button class="wm-faq__trigger">
          <span class="wm-faq__question">Who uses CE&S?</span>
          <svg class="wm-faq__icon" viewbox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2"><path d="M6 9l6 6 6-6"></path></svg>
        </button>
        <div class="wm-faq__panel">
          <div class="wm-faq__content">
            <p>The platform is used by institutional effectiveness and institutional research offices, teaching and learning centers, academic leadership, department chairs, and faculty members involved in evaluation, assessment, and instructional improvement. Students are the most essential user, participating in the surveys that drive all the data.</p>
          </div>
        </div>
      </div>

      <div class="wm-faq__item">
        <button class="wm-faq__trigger">
          <span class="wm-faq__question">What challenges does CE&S help solve?</span>
          <svg class="wm-faq__icon" viewbox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2"><path d="M6 9l6 6 6-6"></path></svg>
        </button>
        <div class="wm-faq__panel">
          <div class="wm-faq__content">
            <p>It helps institutions address low survey response rates, inconsistent evaluation processes, fragmented survey tools, limited reporting capabilities, and difficulty connecting feedback to actionable improvements.</p>
          </div>
        </div>
      </div>

      <div class="wm-faq__item">
        <button class="wm-faq__trigger">
          <span class="wm-faq__question">How does CE&S help institutions collect course feedback?</span>
          <svg class="wm-faq__icon" viewbox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2"><path d="M6 9l6 6 6-6"></path></svg>
        </button>
        <div class="wm-faq__panel">
          <div class="wm-faq__content">
            <p>The platform enables institutions to deploy standardized or customized surveys, collect responses from students, and ensure consistent evaluation processes across departments and programs.</p>
          </div>
        </div>
      </div>

      <div class="wm-faq__item">
        <button class="wm-faq__trigger">
          <span class="wm-faq__question">Can I customize course evaluation surveys?</span>
          <svg class="wm-faq__icon" viewbox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2"><path d="M6 9l6 6 6-6"></path></svg>
        </button>
        <div class="wm-faq__panel">
          <div class="wm-faq__content">
            <p>Yes, surveys can be tailored at multiple levels, including by the instructor. Questions can be tailored to align with institutional priorities, teaching models, program requirements, or accreditation standards.</p>
          </div>
        </div>
      </div>

        <div class="wm-faq__item">
        <button class="wm-faq__trigger">
          <span class="wm-faq__question">How will CE&S improve survey response rates?</span>
          <svg class="wm-faq__icon" viewbox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2"><path d="M6 9l6 6 6-6"></path></svg>
        </button>
        <div class="wm-faq__panel">
          <div class="wm-faq__content">
            <p>First and foremost by putting surveys right where students are learning – inside their LMS. With automated reminders and prompts to drive participation. Other key response rate drivers include transparent response rate tracking for administrators and instructors, automated email programs, and SMS outreach options that can be used together to reach students at the right time and place for them.</p>
          </div>
        </div>
      </div>

        <div class="wm-faq__item">
        <button class="wm-faq__trigger">
          <span class="wm-faq__question">Can course evaluation data be used for faculty review?</span>
          <svg class="wm-faq__icon" viewbox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2"><path d="M6 9l6 6 6-6"></path></svg>
        </button>
        <div class="wm-faq__panel">
          <div class="wm-faq__content">
            <p>Yes. Institutions often use aggregated and structured evaluation data to support faculty annual reviews, promotion processes, and teaching effectiveness documentation.     var offset = current * getCardWidth();
    track.style.transform = 'translateX(-' + offset + 'px)';
    
    if (!animate) {
      // Forzamos un reflow para que el navegador procese el cambio sin transición
      track.offsetHeight; 
      track.style.transition = '';
    }
  }

  function next() {
    if (isTransitioning) return;
    current++;
    track.style.transition = 'transform 0.5s ease-in-out'; // Aseguramos que haya transición
    update(true);

    // --- 2. EL TRUCO DEL INFINITO ---
    // Si llegamos al índice que es igual al total original (donde empiezan los clones)
    if (current === total) {
      isTransitioning = true;
      setTimeout(function() {
        track.style.transition = 'none'; // Quitamos animación
        current = 0; // Volvemos al inicio real
        update(false);
        isTransitioning = false;
      }, 500); // Este tiempo debe coincidir con la duración de tu CSS transition
    }
  }

  function prev() {
    if (isTransitioning) return;
    if (current === 0) {
      // Si estamos al inicio y queremos ir atrás, saltamos al clon sin que se note
      track.style.transition = 'none';
      current = total;
      update(false);
      // Pequeño delay para que el salto sin animación ocurra antes de la animación a current-1
      setTimeout(function() {
        current--;
        track.style.transition = 'transform 0.5s ease-in-out';
        update(true);
      }, 10);
    } else {
      current--;
      update(true);
    }
  }

  // Eventos
  btnNext.addEventListener('click', function () {
    stopAutoplay();
    next();
    startAutoplay();
  });

  btnPrev.addEventListener('click', function () {
    stopAutoplay();
    prev();
    startAutoplay();
  });

  function startAutoplay() {
    stopAutoplay();
    autoTimer = setInterval(next, INTERVAL);
  }

  function stopAutoplay() {
    if (autoTimer) { clearInterval(autoTimer); autoTimer = null; }
  }

  section.addEventListener('mouseenter', stopAutoplay);
  section.addEventListener('mouseleave', startAutoplay);

  window.addEventListener('resize', function () {
    visible = window.innerWidth <= 768 ? 1 : 3;
    update(false);
  });

  window.addEventListener('load', function () {
    update(false);
    startAutoplay();
  });

  if (document.readyState === 'complete') {
    update(false);
    startAutoplay();
  }

  function updateCounter() {
  var display = (current % total) + 1;
  document.getElementById('eucCounter').textContent = display + ' of ' + total;
}

function update(animate) {
  if (animate === false) track.style.transition = 'none';
  var offset = current * getCardWidth();
  track.style.transform = 'translateX(-' + offset + 'px)';
  
  if (animate === false) {
    track.offsetHeight;
    track.style.transition = '';
  }
  updateCounter(); //
}
})();
</script>

<section class="wm-faq" id="faqs">
  <div class="wm-faq__container">
    <h2 class="wm-faq__title">FAQs</h2>

    <div class="wm-faq__list">
      <div class="wm-faq__item wm-faq__item--active">
        <button class="wm-faq__trigger">
          <span class="wm-faq__question">What is Watermark Course Evaluations & Surveys (CE&S)?</span>
          <svg class="wm-faq__icon" viewbox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2"><path d="M6 9l6 6 6-6"></path></svg>
        </button>
        <div class="wm-faq__panel">
          <div class="wm-faq__content">
           <p>Watermark Course Evaluations & Surveys is a centralized platform for collecting, managing, and analyzing feedback from students and stakeholders about courses, instructors, and academic programs. It enables institutions to standardize evaluation processes and use feedback to improve teaching and learning.</p>
          </div>
        </div>
      </div>

      <div class="wm-faq__item">
        <button class="wm-faq__trigger">
          <span class="wm-faq__question">I already have a survey tool. What are the benefits of switching?</span>
          <svg class="wm-faq__icon" viewbox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2"><path d="M6 9l6 6 6-6"></path></svg>
        </button>
        <div class="wm-faq__panel">
          <div class="wm-faq__content">
            <p>More than 30 institutions made the switch from their prior vendor to Watermark Course Evaluations & Surveys in the last six months alone. This year, a dozen switched from Blackboard (formerly Anthology), half a dozen from Explorance, and more than half a dozen from Scantron — plus a dozen institutions that moved from generic survey tools to a platform built specifically for student feedback. We make switching seamless, and our work is backed by numerous awards, including the 2026 EdTech Breakthrough Award for Best Course Evaluation Solution. <a href="https://www.watermarkinsights.com/resources/flyer/what-sets-course-evaluations-and-surveys-apart/">See what sets us apart.</a></p>
          </div>
        </div>
      </div>

      <div class="wm-faq__item">
        <button class="wm-faq__trigger">
          <span class="wm-faq__question">Who uses CE&S?</span>
          <svg class="wm-faq__icon" viewbox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2"><path d="M6 9l6 6 6-6"></path></svg>
        </button>
        <div class="wm-faq__panel">
          <div class="wm-faq__content">
            <p>The platform is used by institutional effectiveness and institutional research offices, teaching and learning centers, academic leadership, department chairs, and faculty members involved in evaluation, assessment, and instructional improvement. Students are the most essential user, participating in the surveys that drive all the data.</p>
          </div>
        </div>
      </div>

      <div class="wm-faq__item">
        <button class="wm-faq__trigger">
          <span class="wm-faq__question">What challenges does CE&S help solve?</span>
          <svg class="wm-faq__icon" viewbox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2"><path d="M6 9l6 6 6-6"></path></svg>
        </button>
        <div class="wm-faq__panel">
          <div class="wm-faq__content">
            <p>It helps institutions address low survey response rates, inconsistent evaluation processes, fragmented survey tools, limited reporting capabilities, and difficulty connecting feedback to actionable improvements.</p>
          </div>
        </div>
      </div>

      <div class="wm-faq__item">
        <button class="wm-faq__trigger">
          <span class="wm-faq__question">How does CE&S help institutions collect course feedback?</span>
          <svg class="wm-faq__icon" viewbox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2"><path d="M6 9l6 6 6-6"></path></svg>
        </button>
        <div class="wm-faq__panel">
          <div class="wm-faq__content">
            <p>The platform enables institutions to deploy standardized or customized surveys, collect responses from students, and ensure consistent evaluation processes across departments and programs.</p>
          </div>
        </div>
      </div>

      <div class="wm-faq__item">
        <button class="wm-faq__trigger">
          <span class="wm-faq__question">Can I customize course evaluation surveys?</span>
          <svg class="wm-faq__icon" viewbox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2"><path d="M6 9l6 6 6-6"></path></svg>
        </button>
        <div class="wm-faq__panel">
          <div class="wm-faq__content">
            <p>Yes, surveys can be tailored at multiple levels, including by the instructor. Questions can be tailored to align with institutional priorities, teaching models, program requirements, or accreditation standards.</p>
          </div>
        </div>
      </div>

        <div class="wm-faq__item">
        <button class="wm-faq__trigger">
          <span class="wm-faq__question">How will CE&S improve survey response rates?</span>
          <svg class="wm-faq__icon" viewbox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2"><path d="M6 9l6 6 6-6"></path></svg>
        </button>
        <div class="wm-faq__panel">
          <div class="wm-faq__content">
            <p>First and foremost by putting surveys right where students are learning – inside their LMS. With automated reminders and prompts to drive participation. Other key response rate drivers include transparent response rate tracking for administrators and instructors, automated email programs, and SMS outreach options that can be used together to reach students at the right time and place for them.</p>
          </div>
        </div>
      </div>

        <div class="wm-faq__item">
        <button class="wm-faq__trigger">
          <span class="wm-faq__question">Can course evaluation data be used for faculty review?</span>
          <svg class="wm-faq__icon" viewbox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2"><path d="M6 9l6 6 6-6"></path></svg>
        </button>
        <div class="wm-faq__panel">
          <div class="wm-faq__content">
            <p>Yes. Institutions often use aggregated and structured evaluation data to support faculty annual reviews, promotion processes, and teaching effectiveness documentation. CE&S is often integrated with <a href="https://www.watermarkinsights.com/resources/flyer/watermark-course-evaluations-surveys-faculty-success/">Faculty Success</a> to streamline this further.</p>
          </div>
        </div>
      </div>

        <div class="wm-faq__item">
        <button class="wm-faq__trigger">
          <span class="wm-faq__question">How are course evaluations used for accreditation?</span>
          <svg class="wm-faq__icon" viewbox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2"><path d="M6 9l6 6 6-6"></path></svg>
        </button>
        <div class="wm-faq__panel">
          <div class="wm-faq__content">
            <p>Course evaluation data provides evidence of teaching effectiveness and student experience, which can be used in accreditation reports and institutional effectiveness documentation.</p>
          </div>
        </div>
      </div>

  <div class="wm-faq__item">
        <button class="wm-faq__trigger">
          <span class="wm-faq__question">How do Watermark Course Evaluations & Surveys and Faculty Success work together?</span>
          <svg class="wm-faq__icon" viewbox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2"><path d="M6 9l6 6 6-6"></path></svg>
        </button>
        <div class="wm-faq__panel">
          <div class="wm-faq__content">
            <p>Watermark Course Evaluations & Surveys connects directly with Watermark Faculty Success. Once an evaluation project is complete, an authorized administrator can sync evaluation reports to the corresponding Scheduled Teaching records in Faculty Success. This gives instructors access to student feedback alongside their course and faculty activity information.</p>
          </div>
        </div>
      </div>
   <div class="wm-faq__item">
        <button class="wm-faq__trigger">
          <span class="wm-faq__question">Do faculty have to manually export and import course evaluation results?</span>
          <svg class="wm-faq__icon" viewbox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2"><path d="M6 9l6 6 6-6"></path></svg>
        </button>
        <div class="wm-faq__panel">

<script>
(function () {
  var track     = document.getElementById('eucTrack');
  var btnPrev   = document.getElementById('eucPrev');
  var btnNext   = document.getElementById('eucNext');
  var section   = track.closest('.euc-section') || track.parentNode.parentNode.parentNode;

  var cards     = track.querySelectorAll('.euc-card');
  var total     = cards.length;
  var visible   = window.innerWidth <= 768 ? 1 : 3;
  var current   = 0;
  var isTransitioning = false; // Bloqueo para evitar clics dobles durante la animación
  var autoTimer = null;
  var INTERVAL  = 3000; 

  // --- 1. PREPARACIÓN PARA LOOP INFINITO ---
  // Clonamos los primeros 'visible' elementos y los añadimos al final
  for (var i = 0; i < visible; i++) {
    var clone = cards[i].cloneNode(true);
    track.appendChild(clone);
  }

  function getCardWidth() {
    var w = cards[0].offsetWidth;
    if (!w) w = cards[0].getBoundingClientRect().width;
    return w + 24; // Ancho + Gap
  }

  function update(animate = true) {
    if (!animate) track.style.transition = 'none';
    var offset = current * getCardWidth();
    track.style.transform = 'translateX(-' + offset + 'px)';
    
    if (!animate) {
      // Forzamos un reflow para que el navegador procese el cambio sin transición
      track.offsetHeight; 
      track.style.transition = '';
    }
  }

  function next() {
    if (isTransitioning) return;
    current++;
    track.style.transition = 'transform 0.5s ease-in-out'; // Aseguramos que haya transición
    update(true);

    // --- 2. EL TRUCO DEL INFINITO ---
    // Si llegamos al índice que es igual al total original (donde empiezan los clones)
    if (current === total) {
      isTransitioning = true;
      setTimeout(function() {
        track.style.transition = 'none'; // Quitamos animación
        current = 0; // Volvemos al inicio real
        update(false);
        isTransitioning = false;
      }, 500); // Este tiempo debe coincidir con la duración de tu CSS transition
    }
  }

  function prev() {
    if (isTransitioning) return;
    if (current === 0) {
      // Si estamos al inicio y queremos ir atrás, saltamos al clon sin que se note
      track.style.transition = 'none';
      current = total;
      update(false);
      // Pequeño delay para que el salto sin animación ocurra antes de la animación a current-1
      setTimeout(function() {
        current--;
        track.style.transition = 'transform 0.5s ease-in-out';
        update(true);
      }, 10);
    } else {
      current--;
      update(true);
    }
  }

  // Eventos
  btnNext.addEventListener('click', function () {
    stopAutoplay();
    next();
    startAutoplay();
  });

  btnPrev.addEventListener('click', function () {
    stopAutoplay();
    prev();
    startAutoplay();
  });

  function startAutoplay() {
    stopAutoplay();
    autoTimer = setInterval(next, INTERVAL);
  }

  function stopAutoplay() {
    if (autoTimer) { clearInterval(autoTimer); autoTimer = null; }
  }

  section.addEventListener('mouseenter', stopAutoplay);
  section.addEventListener('mouseleave', startAutoplay);

  window.addEventListener('resize', function () {
    visible = window.innerWidth <= 768 ? 1 : 3;
    update(false);

<section class="wm-faq" id="faqs">
  <div class="wm-faq__container">
    <h2 class="wm-faq__title">FAQs</h2>

    <div class="wm-faq__list">
      <div class="wm-faq__item wm-faq__item--active">
        <button class="wm-faq__trigger">
          <span class="wm-faq__question">What is Watermark Course Evaluations & Surveys (CE&S)?</span>
          <svg class="wm-faq__icon" viewbox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2"><path d="M6 9l6 6 6-6"></path></svg>
        </button>
        <div class="wm-faq__panel">
          <div class="wm-faq__content">
           <p>Watermark Course Evaluations & Surveys is a centralized platform for collecting, managing, and analyzing feedback from students and stakeholders about courses, instructors, and academic programs. It enables institutions to standardize evaluation processes and use feedback to improve teaching and learning.</p>
          </div>
        </div>
      </div>

      <div class="wm-faq__item">
        <button class="wm-faq__trigger">
          <span class="wm-faq__question">I already have a survey tool. What are the benefits of switching?</span>
          <svg class="wm-faq__icon" viewbox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2"><path d="M6 9l6 6 6-6"></path></svg>
        </button>
        <div class="wm-faq__panel">
          <div class="wm-faq__content">
            <p>More than 30 institutions made the switch from their prior vendor to Watermark Course Evaluations & Surveys in the last six months alone. This year, a dozen switched from Blackboard (formerly Anthology), half a dozen from Explorance, and more than half a dozen from Scantron — plus a dozen institutions that moved from generic survey tools to a platform built specifically for student feedback. We make switching seamless, and our work is backed by numerous awards, including the 2026 EdTech Breakthrough Award for Best Course Evaluation Solution. <a href="https://www.watermarkinsights.com/resources/flyer/what-sets-course-evaluations-and-surveys-apart/">See what sets us apart.</a></p>
          </div>
        </div>
      </div>

      <div class="wm-faq__item">
        <button class="wm-faq__trigger">
          <span class="wm-faq__question">Who uses CE&S?</span>
          <svg class="wm-faq__icon" viewbox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2"><path d="M6 9l6 6 6-6"></path></svg>
        </button>
        <div class="wm-faq__panel">
          <div class="wm-faq__content">
            <p>The platform is used by institutional effectiveness and institutional research offices, teaching and learning centers, academic leadership, department chairs, and faculty members involved in evaluation, assessment, and instructional improvement. Students are the most essential user, participating in the surveys that drive all the data.</p>
          </div>
        </div>
      </div>

      <div class="wm-faq__item">
        <button class="wm-faq__trigger">
          <span class="wm-faq__question">What challenges does CE&S help solve?</span>
          <svg class="wm-faq__icon" viewbox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2"><path d="M6 9l6 6 6-6"></path></svg>
        </button>
        <div class="wm-faq__panel">
          <div class="wm-faq__content">
            <p>It helps institutions address low survey response rates, inconsistent evaluation processes, fragmented survey tools, limited reporting capabilities, and difficulty connecting feedback to actionable improvements.</p>
          </div>
        </div>
      </div>

      <div class="wm-faq__item">
        <button class="wm-faq__trigger">
          <span class="wm-faq__question">How does CE&S help institutions collect course feedback?</span>
          <svg class="wm-faq__icon" viewbox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2"><path d="M6 9l6 6 6-6"></path></svg>
        </button>
        <div class="wm-faq__panel">
          <div class="wm-faq__content">
            <p>The platform enables institutions to deploy standardized or customized surveys, collect responses from students, and ensure consistent evaluation processes across departments and programs.</p>
          </div>
        </div>
      </div>

      <div class="wm-faq__item">
        <button class="wm-faq__trigger">
          <span class="wm-faq__question">Can I customize course evaluation surveys?</span>
          <svg class="wm-faq__icon" viewbox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2"><path d="M6 9l6 6 6-6"></path></svg>
        </button>
        <div class="wm-faq__panel">
          <div class="wm-faq__content">
            <p>Yes, surveys can be tailored at multiple levels, including by the instructor. Questions can be tailored to align with institutional priorities, teaching models, program requirements, or accreditation standards.</p>
          </div>
        </div>
      </div>

        <div class="wm-faq__item">
        <button class="wm-faq__trigger">
          <span class="wm-faq__question">How will CE&S improve survey response rates?</span>
          <svg class="wm-faq__icon" viewbox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2"><path d="M6 9l6 6 6-6"></path></svg>
        </button>
        <div class="wm-faq__panel">
          <div class="wm-faq__content">
            <p>First and foremost by putting surveys right where students are learning – inside their LMS. With automated reminders and prompts to drive participation. Other key response rate drivers include transparent response rate tracking for administrators and instructors, automated email programs, and SMS outreach options that can be used together to reach students at the right time and place for them.</p>
          </div>
        </div>
      </div>

        <div class="wm-faq__item">
        <button class="wm-faq__trigger">
          <span class="wm-faq__question">Can course evaluation data be used for faculty review?</span>
          <svg class="wm-faq__icon" viewbox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2"><path d="M6 9l6 6 6-6"></path></svg>
        </button>
        <div class="wm-faq__panel">
          <div class="wm-faq__content">
            <p>Yes. Institutions often use aggregated and structured evaluation data to support faculty annual reviews, promotion processes, and teaching effectiveness documentation. CE&S is often integrated with <a href="https://www.watermarkinsights.com/resources/flyer/watermark-course-evaluations-surveys-faculty-success/">Faculty Success</a> to streamline this further.</p>
          </div>
        </div>
      </div>

        <div class="wm-faq__item">
        <button class="wm-faq__trigger">
          <span class="wm-faq__question">How are course evaluations used for accreditation?</span>
          <svg class="wm-faq__icon" viewbox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2"><path d="M6 9l6 6 6-6"></path></svg>
        </button>
        <div class="wm-faq__panel">
          <div class="wm-faq__content">
            <p>Course evaluation data provides evidence of teaching effectiveness and student experience, which can be used in accreditation reports and institutional effectiveness documentation.</p>
          </div>
        </div>
      </div>

  <div class="wm-faq__item">
        <button class="wm-faq__trigger">
          <span class="wm-faq__question">How do Watermark Course Evaluations & Surveys and Faculty Success work together?</span>
          <svg class="wm-faq__icon" viewbox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2"><path d="M6 9l6 6 6-6"></path></svg>
        </button>
        <div class="wm-faq__panel">
          <div class="wm-faq__content">
            <p>Watermark Course Evaluations & Surveys connects directly with Watermark Faculty Success. Once an evaluation project is complete, an authorized administrator can sync evaluation reports to the corresponding Scheduled Teaching records in Faculty Success. This gives instructors access to student feedback alongside their course and faculty activity information.</p>
          </div>
        </div>
      </div>
   <div class="wm-faq__item">
        <button class="wm-faq__trigger">
          <span class="wm-faq__question">Do faculty have to manually export and import course evaluation results?</span>
          <svg class="wm-faq__icon" viewbox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2"><path d="M6 9l6 6 6-6"></path></svg>
        </button>
        <div class="wm-faq__panel">
          <div class="wm-faq__content">
            <p>No. Faculty do not need to download spreadsheets, upload evaluation results or re-enter the data in Faculty Success. Once the integration is configured, an administrator initiates the sync and the software automatically matches the evaluation reports with the appropriate teaching records.</p>
          </div>
        </div>
      </div>

  <div class="wm-faq__item">
        <button class="wm-faq__trigger">
          <span class="wm-faq__question">Can course evaluation results be included in faculty review materials?</span>
          <svg class="wm-faq__icon" viewbox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2"><path d="M6 9l6 6 6-6"></path></svg>
        </button>
        <div class="wm-faq__panel">
          <div class="wm-faq__content">
            <p>Yes. Course evaluation reports synced from CES can be accessed through Faculty Success and included as links within configured Faculty Success reports. This allows institutions to incorporate student feedback into annual review, promotion and tenure, and faculty development processes while maintaining appropriate permissions. <a href="https://support.watermarkinsights.com/hc/en-us/articles/37600378650139-How-to-Include-CES-Reports-in-your-Faculty-Success-Reports?utm_source=chatgpt.com">Including CES reports in Faculty Success reports</a>
</p>
          </div>
        </div>
      </div>

  <div class="wm-faq__item">
        <button class="wm-faq__trigger">
          <span class="wm-faq__question">Is Watermark one platform or two separate platforms?</span>
          <svg class="wm-faq__icon" viewbox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2"><path d="M6 9l6 6 6-6"></path></svg>
        </button>
        <div class="wm-faq__panel">
          <div class="wm-faq__content">
            <p>Course Evaluations & Surveys and Faculty Success are purpose-built Watermark solutions that can be used independently or connected. When used together, they provide a connected workflow from collecting student feedback to making evaluation reports available with faculty teaching and activity records. This gives institutions specialized capabilities without requiring faculty to move data manually between systems.
</p>
          </div>
        </div>
      </div>

 <div class="wm-faq__item">
        <button class="wm-faq__trigger">
          <span class="wm-faq__question">How does Faculty Success reduce manual data entry for faculty?</span>
          <svg class="wm-faq__icon" viewbox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2"><path d="M6 9l6 6 6-6"></path></svg>
        </button>
        <div class="wm-faq__panel">
          <div class="wm-faq__content">
            <p>Faculty Success offers several ways to quickly build and maintain a faculty profile. Faculty can use AI-powered CV imports, connect to sources including ORCID, Scopus, PubMed and Crossref, import citation files, or review publications identified through proactive searches. Faculty can then verify and supplement the information rather than entering every activity manually. <a href="https://www.watermarkinsights.com/solutions/faculty-success">Faculty Success product page</a>

</p>
          </div>
        </div>

<script>
(function () {
  var track     = document.getElementById('eucTrack');
  var btnPrev   = document.getElementById('eucPrev');
  var btnNext   = document.getElementById('eucNext');
  var section   = track.closest('.euc-section') || track.parentNode.parentNode.parentNode;

  var cards     = track.querySelectorAll('.euc-card');
  var total     = cards.length;
  var visible   = window.innerWidth <= 768 ? 1 : 3;
  var current   = 0;
  var isTransitioning = false; // Bloqueo para evitar clics dobles durante la animación
  var autoTimer = null;
  var INTERVAL  = 3000; 

  // --- 1. PREPARACIÓN PARA LOOP INFINITO ---
  // Clonamos los primeros 'visible' elementos y los añadimos al final
  for (var i = 0; i < visible; i++) {
    var clone = cards[i].cloneNode(true);
    track.appendChild(clone);
  }

  function getCardWidth() {
    var w = cards[0].offsetWidth;
    if (!w) w = cards[0].getBoundingClientRect().width;
    return w + 24; // Ancho + Gap
  }

  function update(animate = true) {
    if (!animate) track.style.transition = 'none';
    var offset = current * getCardWidth();
    track.style.transform = 'translateX(-' + offset + 'px)';
    
    if (!animate) {
      // Forzamos un reflow para que el navegador procese el cambio sin transición
      track.offsetHeight; 
      track.style.transition = '';
    }
  }

  function next() {
    if (isTransitioning) return;
    current++;
    track.style.transition = 'transform 0.5s ease-in-out'; // Aseguramos que haya transición
    update(true);

    // --- 2. EL TRUCO DEL INFINITO ---
    // Si llegamos al índice que es igual al total original (donde empiezan los clones)
    if (current === total) {
      isTransitioning = true;
      setTimeout(function() {
        track.style.transition = 'none'; // Quitamos animación
        current = 0; // Volvemos al inicio real
        update(false);
        isTransitioning = false;
      }, 500); // Este tiempo debe coincidir con la duración de tu CSS transition
    }
  }

  function prev() {
    if (isTransitioning) return;
    if (current === 0) {
      // Si estamos al inicio y queremos ir atrás, saltamos al clon sin que se note
      track.style.transition = 'none';
      current = total;
      update(false);
      // Pequeño delay para que el salto sin animación ocurra antes de la animación a current-1
      setTimeout(function() {
        current--;
        track.style.transition = 'transform 0.5s ease-in-out';
        update(true);
      }, 10);
    } else {
      current--;
      update(true);
    }
  }

  // Eventos
  btnNext.addEventListener('click', function () {
    stopAutoplay();
    next();
    startAutoplay();
  });

  btnPrev.addEventListener('click', function () {
    stopAutoplay();
    prev();
    startAutoplay();
  });

  function startAutoplay() {
    stopAutoplay();
    autoTimer = setInterval(next, INTERVAL);
  }

  function stopAutoplay() {
    if (autoTimer) { clearInterval(autoTimer); autoTimer = null; }
  }

  section.addEventListener('mouseenter', stopAutoplay);
  section.addEventListener('mouseleave', startAutoplay);

  window.addEventListener('resize', function () {
    visible = window.innerWidth <= 768 ? 1 : 3;
    update(false);
  });

  window.addEventListener('load', function () {
    update(false);
    startAutoplay();
  });

  if (document.readyState === 'complete') {
    update(false);
    startAutoplay();
  }

  function updateCounter() {
  var display = (current % total) + 1;
  document.getElementById('eucCounter').textContent = display + ' of ' + total;
}

function update(animate) {
  if (animate === false) track.style.transition = 'none';
  var offset = current * getCardWidth();
  track.style.transform = 'translateX(-' + offset + 'px)';
  
  if (animate === false) {
    track.offsetHeight;
    track.style.transition = '';
  }
  updateCounter(); //
}
})();
</script>

<section class="wm-faq" id="faqs">
  <div class="wm-faq__container">
    <h2 class="wm-faq__title">FAQs</h2>

    <div class="wm-faq__list">
      <div class="wm-faq__item wm-faq__item--active">
        <button class="wm-faq__trigger">
          <span class="wm-faq__question">What is Watermark Course Evaluations & Surveys (CE&S)?</span>
          <svg class="wm-faq__icon" viewbox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2"><path d="M6 9l6 6 6-6"></path></svg>
        </button>
        <div class="wm-faq__panel">
          <div class="wm-faq__content">
           <p>Watermark Course Evaluations & Surveys is a centralized platform for collecting, managing, and analyzing feedback from students and stakeholders about courses, instructors, and academic programs. It enables institutions to standardize evaluation processes and use feedback to improve teaching and learning.</p>
          </div>
        </div>
      </div>

      <div class="wm-faq__item">
        <button class="wm-faq__trigger">
          <span class="wm-faq__question">I already have a survey tool. What are the benefits of switching?</span>
          <svg class="wm-faq__icon" viewbox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2"><path d="M6 9l6 6 6-6"></path></svg>
        </button>
        <div class="wm-faq__panel">
          <div class="wm-faq__content">
            <p>More than 30 institutions made the switch from their prior vendor to Watermark Course Evaluations & Surveys in the last six months alone. This year, a dozen switched from Blackboard (formerly Anthology), half a dozen from Explorance, and more than half a dozen from Scantron — plus a dozen institutions that moved from generic survey tools to a platform built specifically for student feedback. We make switching seamless, and our work is backed by numerous awards, including the 2026 EdTech Breakthrough Award for Best Course Evaluation Solution. <a href="https://www.watermarkinsights.com/resources/flyer/what-sets-course-evaluations-and-surveys-apart/">See what sets us apart.</a></p>
          </div>
        </div>
      </div>

      <div class="wm-faq__item">
        <button class="wm-faq__trigger">
          <span class="wm-faq__question">Who uses CE&S?</span>
          <svg class="wm-faq__icon" viewbox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2"><path d="M6 9l6 6 6-6"></path></svg>
        </button>
        <div class="wm-faq__panel">
          <div class="wm-faq__content">
            <p>The platform is used by institutional effectiveness and institutional research offices, teaching and learning centers, academic leadership, department chairs, and faculty members involved in evaluation, assessment, and instructional improvement. Students are the most essential user, participating in the surveys that drive all the data.</p>
          </div>
        </div>
      </div>

      <div class="wm-faq__item">
        <button class="wm-faq__trigger">
          <span class="wm-faq__question">What challenges does CE&S help solve?</span>
          <svg class="wm-faq__icon" viewbox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2"><path d="M6 9l6 6 6-6"></path></svg>
        </button>
        <div class="wm-faq__panel">
          <div class="wm-faq__content">
            <p>It helps institutions address low survey response rates, inconsistent evaluation processes, fragmented survey tools, limited reporting capabilities, and difficulty connecting feedback to actionable improvements.</p>
          </div>
        </div>
      </div>

      <div class="wm-faq__item">
        <button class="wm-faq__trigger">
          <span class="wm-faq__question">How does CE&S help institutions collect course feedback?</span>
          <svg class="wm-faq__icon" viewbox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2"><path d="M6 9l6 6 6-6"></path></svg>
        </button>
        <div class="wm-faq__panel">
          <div class="wm-faq__content">
            <p>The platform enables institutions to deploy standardized or customized surveys, collect responses from students, and ensure consistent evaluation processes across departments and programs.</p>
          </div>
        </div>
      </div>

      <div class="wm-faq__item">
        <button class="wm-faq__trigger">
          <span class="wm-faq__question">Can I customize course evaluation surveys?</span>
          <svg class="wm-faq__icon" viewbox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2"><path d="M6 9l6 6 6-6"></path></svg>
        </button>
        <div class="wm-faq__panel">
          <div class="wm-faq__content">
            <p>Yes, surveys can be tailored at multiple levels, including by the instructor. Questions can be tailored to align with institutional priorities, teaching models, program requirements, or accreditation standards.</p>
          </div>
        </div>
      </div>

        <div class="wm-faq__item">
        <button class="wm-faq__trigger">
          <span class="wm-faq__question">How will CE&S improve survey response rates?</span>
          <svg class="wm-faq__icon" viewbox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2"><path d="M6 9l6 6 6-6"></path></svg>
        </button>
        <div class="wm-faq__panel">
          <div class="wm-faq__content">
            <p>First and foremost by putting surveys right where students are learning – inside their LMS. With automated reminders and prompts to drive participation. Other key response rate drivers include transparent response rate tracking for administrators and instructors, automated email programs, and SMS outreach options that can be used together to reach students at the right time and place for them.</p>
          </div>
        </div>
      </div>

        <div class="wm-faq__item">
        <button class="wm-faq__trigger">
          <span class="wm-faq__question">Can course evaluation data be used for faculty review?</span>
          <svg class="wm-faq__icon" viewbox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2"><path d="M6 9l6 6 6-6"></path></svg>
        </button>
        <div class="wm-faq__panel">
          <div class="wm-faq__content">
            <p>Yes. Institutions often use aggregated and structured evaluation data to support faculty annual reviews, promotion processes, and teaching effectiveness documentation. CE&S is often integrated with <a href="https://www.watermarkinsights.com/resources/flyer/watermark-course-evaluations-surveys-faculty-success/">Faculty Success</a> to streamline this further.</p>
          </div>
        </div>
      </div>

        <div class="wm-faq__item">
        <button class="wm-faq__trigger">
          <span class="wm-faq__question">How are course evaluations used for accreditation?</span>
          <svg class="wm-faq__icon" viewbox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2"><path d="M6 9l6 6 6-6"></path></svg>
        </button>
        <div class="wm-faq__panel">
          <div class="wm-faq__content">
            <p>Course evaluation data provides evidence of teaching effectiveness and student experience, which can be used in accreditation reports and institutional effectiveness documentation.</p>
          </div>
        </div>
      </div>

  <div class="wm-faq__item">
        <button class="wm-faq__trigger">
          <span class="wm-faq__question">How do Watermark Course Evaluations & Surveys and Faculty Success work together?</span>
          <svg class="wm-faq__icon" viewbox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2"><path d="M6 9l6 6 6-6"></path></svg>
        </button>
        <div class="wm-faq__panel">
          <div class="wm-faq__content">
            <p>Watermark Course Evaluations & Surveys connects directly with Watermark Faculty Success. Once an evaluation project is complete, an authorized administrator can sync evaluation reports to the corresponding Scheduled Teaching records in Faculty Success. This gives instructors access to student feedback alongside their course and faculty activity information.</p>
          </div>
        </div>
      </div>
   <div class="wm-faq__item">
        <button class="wm-faq__trigger">
          <span class="wm-faq__question">Do faculty have to manually export and import course evaluation results?</span>
          <svg class="wm-faq__icon" viewbox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2"><path d="M6 9l6 6 6-6"></path></svg>
        </button>
        <div class="wm-faq__panel">
          <div class="wm-faq__content">
            <p>No. Faculty do not need to download spreadsheets, upload evaluation results or re-enter the data in Faculty Success. Once the integration is configured, an administrator initiates the sync and the software automatically matches the evaluation reports with the appropriate teaching records.</p>
          </div>
        </div>
      </div>

  <div class="wm-faq__item">
        <button class="wm-faq__trigger">
          <span class="wm-faq__question">Can course evaluation results be included in faculty review materials?</span>
          <svg class="wm-faq__icon" viewbox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2"><path d="M6 9l6 6 6-6"></path></svg>
        </button>
        <div class="wm-faq__panel">
          <div class="wm-faq__content">
            <p>Yes. Course evaluation reports synced from CES can be accessed through Faculty Success and included as links within configured Faculty Success reports. This allows institutions to incorporate student feedback into annual review, promotion and tenure, and faculty development processes while maintaining appropriate permissions. <a href="https://support.watermarkinsights.com/hc/en-us/articles/37600378650139-How-to-Include-CES-Reports-in-your-Faculty-Success-Reports?utm_source=chatgpt.com">Including CES reports in Faculty Success reports</a>
</p>
          </div>
        </div>
      </div>

  <div class="wm-faq__item">
        <button class="wm-faq__trigger">
          <span class="wm-faq__question">Is Watermark one platform or two separate platforms?</span>
          <svg class="wm-faq__icon" viewbox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2"><path d="M6 9l6 6 6-6"></path></svg>
        </button>
        <div class="wm-faq__panel">
          <div class="wm-faq__content">
            <p>Course Evaluations & Surveys and Faculty Success are purpose-built Watermark solutions that can be used independently or connected. When used together, they provide a connected workflow from collecting student feedback to making evaluation reports available with faculty teaching and activity records. This gives institutions specialized capabilities without requiring faculty to move data manually between systems.
</p>
          </div>
        </div>
      </div>

 <div class="wm-faq__item">
        <button class="wm-faq__trigger">
          <span class="wm-faq__question">How does Faculty Success reduce manual data entry for faculty?</span>
          <svg class="wm-faq__icon" viewbox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2"><path d="M6 9l6 6 6-6"></path></svg>
        </button>
        <div class="wm-faq__panel">
          <div class="wm-faq__content">
            <p>Faculty Success offers several ways to quickly build and maintain a faculty profile. Faculty can use AI-powered CV imports, connect to sources including ORCID, Scopus, PubMed and Crossref, import citation files, or review publications identified through proactive searches. Faculty can then verify and supplement the information rather than entering every activity manually. <a href="https://www.watermarkinsights.com/solutions/faculty-success">Faculty Success product page</a>

</p>
          </div>
        </div>
      </div>

 <div class="wm-faq__item">
        <button class="wm-faq__trigger">
          <span class="wm-faq__question">Can I send survey notifications by text message?</span>
          <svg class="wm-faq__icon" viewbox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2"><path d="M6 9l6 6 6-6"></path></svg>
        </button>
        <div class="wm-faq__panel">
          <div class="wm-faq__content">
            <p>Yes. <a href="https://www.watermarkinsights.com/resources/flyer/watermark-course-evaluations-and-surveys-text-messaging/"> Text messaging</a> is available as an add-on for institutions in the US, giving administrators a third way to reach students alongside email and LMS notifications. It works the same way you already schedule email communications, with automatic opt-out and consent tracking built in to meet TCPA requirements. Ask your Watermark representative to add it to your agreement.
</p>
          </div>
        </div>
      </div>

      </div>
  </div>
</section>

<script>
(function () {
  var track     = document.getElementById('eucTrack');
  var btnPrev   = document.getElementById('eucPrev');
  var btnNext   = document.getElementById('eucNext');
  var section   = track.closest('.euc-section') || track.parentNode.parentNode.parentNode;

  var cards     = track.querySelectorAll('.euc-card');
  var total     = cards.length;
  var visible   = window.innerWidth <= 768 ? 1 : 3;
  var current   = 0;
  var isTransitioning = false; // Bloqueo para evitar clics dobles durante la animación
  var autoTimer = null;
  var INTERVAL  = 3000; 

  // --- 1. PREPARACIÓN PARA LOOP INFINITO ---
  // Clonamos los primeros 'visible' elementos y los añadimos al final
  for (var i = 0; i < visible; i++) {
    var clone = cards[i].cloneNode(true);
    track.appendChild(clone);
  }

  function getCardWidth() {
    var w = cards[0].offsetWidth;
    if (!w) w = cards[0].getBoundingClientRect().width;
    return w + 24; // Ancho + Gap
  }

  function update(animate = true) {
    if (!animate) track.style.transition = 'none';
    var offset = current * getCardWidth();
    track.style.transform = 'translateX(-' + offset + 'px)';
    
    if (!animate) {
      // Forzamos un reflow para que el navegador procese el cambio sin transición
      track.offsetHeight; 
      track.style.transition = '';
    }
  }

  function next() {
    if (isTransitioning) return;
    current++;
    track.style.transition = 'transform 0.5s ease-in-out'; // Aseguramos que haya transición
    update(true);

    // --- 2. EL TRUCO DEL INFINITO ---
    // Si llegamos al índice que es igual al total original (donde empiezan los clones)
    if (current === total) {
      isTransitioning = true;
      setTimeout(function() {
        track.style.transition = 'none'; // Quitamos animación
        current = 0; // Volvemos al inicio real
        update(false);
        isTransitioning = false;
      }, 500); // Este tiempo debe coincidir con la duración de tu CSS transition
    }
  }

  function prev() {
    if (isTransitioning) return;
    if (current === 0) {
      // Si estamos al inicio y queremos ir atrás, saltamos al clon sin que se note
      track.style.transition = 'none';
      current = total;
      update(false);
      // Pequeño delay para que el salto sin animación ocurra antes de la animación a current-1
      setTimeout(function() {
        current--;
        track.style.transition = 'transform 0.5s ease-in-out';
        update(true);
      }, 10);
    } else {
      current--;
      update(true);
    }
  }

  // Eventos
  btnNext.addEventListener('click', function () {
    stopAutoplay();
    next();
    startAutoplay();
  });

  btnPrev.addEventListener('click', function () {
    stopAutoplay();
    prev();
    startAutoplay();
  });

  function startAutoplay() {
    stopAutoplay();
    autoTimer = setInterval(next, INTERVAL);
  }

  function stopAutoplay() {
    if (autoTimer) { clearInterval(autoTimer); autoTimer = null; }
  }

  section.addEventListener('mouseenter', stopAutoplay);
  section.addEventListener('mouseleave', startAutoplay);

  window.addEventListener('resize', function () {
    visible = window.innerWidth <= 768 ? 1 : 3;
    update(false);
  });

  window.addEventListener('load', function () {
    update(false);
    startAutoplay();
  });

  if (document.readyState === 'complete') {
    update(false);
    startAutoplay();
  }

  function updateCounter() {
  var display = (current % total) + 1;
  document.getElementById('eucCounter').textContent = display + ' of ' + total;
}

function update(animate) {
  if (animate === false) track.style.transition = 'none';
  var offset = current * getCardWidth();
  track.style.transform = 'translateX(-' + offset + 'px)';
  
  if (animate === false) {
    track.offsetHeight;
    track.style.transition = '';
  }
  updateCounter(); //
}
})();
</script>

<section class="wm-faq" id="faqs">
  <div class="wm-faq__container">
    <h2 class="wm-faq__title">FAQs</h2>

    <div class="wm-faq__list">
      <div class="wm-faq__item wm-faq__item--active">
        <button class="wm-faq__trigger">
          <span class="wm-faq__question">What is Watermark Course Evaluations & Surveys (CE&S)?</span>
          <svg class="wm-faq__icon" viewbox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2"><path d="M6 9l6 6 6-6"></path></svg>
        </button>
        <div class="wm-faq__panel">
          <div class="wm-faq__content">
           <p>Watermark Course Evaluations & Surveys is a centralized platform for collecting, managing, and analyzing feedback from students and stakeholders about courses, instructors, and academic programs. It enables institutions to standardize evaluation processes and use feedback to improve teaching and learning.</p>
          </div>
        </div>
      </div>

      <div class="wm-faq__item">
        <button class="wm-faq__trigger">
          <span class="wm-faq__question">I already have a survey tool. What are the benefits of switching?</span>
          <svg class="wm-faq__icon" viewbox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2"><path d="M6 9l6 6 6-6"></path></svg>
        </button>
        <div class="wm-faq__panel">
          <div class="wm-faq__content">
            <p>More than 30 institutions made the switch from their prior vendor to Watermark Course Evaluations & Surveys in the last six months alone. This year, a dozen switched from Blackboard (formerly Anthology), half a dozen from Explorance, and more than half a dozen from Scantron — plus a dozen institutions that moved from generic survey tools to a platform built specifically for student feedback. We make switching seamless, and our work is backed by numerous awards, including the 2026 EdTech Breakthrough Award for Best Course Evaluation Solution. <a href="https://www.watermarkinsights.com/resources/flyer/what-sets-course-evaluations-and-surveys-apart/">See what sets us apart.</a></p>
          </div>
        </div>
      </div>

      <div class="wm-faq__item">
        <button class="wm-faq__trigger">
          <span class="wm-faq__question">Who uses CE&S?</span>
          <svg class="wm-faq__icon" viewbox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2"><path d="M6 9l6 6 6-6"></path></svg>
        </button>
        <div class="wm-faq__panel">
          <div class="wm-faq__content">
            <p>The platform is used by institutional effectiveness and institutional research offices, teaching and learning centers, academic leadership, department chairs, and faculty members involved in evaluation, assessment, and instructional improvement. Students are the most essential user, participating in the surveys that drive all the data.</p>
          </div>
        </div>
      </div>

      <div class="wm-faq__item">
        <button class="wm-faq__trigger">
          <span class="wm-faq__question">What challenges does CE&S help solve?</span>
          <svg class="wm-faq__icon" viewbox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2"><path d="M6 9l6 6 6-6"></path></svg>
        </button>
        <div class="wm-faq__panel">
          <div class="wm-faq__content">
            <p>It helps institutions address low survey response rates, inconsistent evaluation processes, fragmented survey tools, limited reporting capabilities, and difficulty connecting feedback to actionable improvements.</p>
          </div>
        </div>
      </div>

      <div class="wm-faq__item">
        <button class="wm-faq__trigger">
          <span class="wm-faq__question">How does CE&S help institutions collect course feedback?</span>
          <svg class="wm-faq__icon" viewbox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2"><path d="M6 9l6 6 6-6"></path></svg>
        </button>
        <div class="wm-faq__panel">
          <div class="wm-faq__content">
            <p>The platform enables institutions to deploy standardized or customized surveys, collect responses from students, and ensure consistent evaluation processes across departments and programs.</p>
          </div>
        </div>
      </div>

      <div class="wm-faq__item">
        <button class="wm-faq__trigger">
          <span class="wm-faq__question">Can I customize course evaluation surveys?</span>
          <svg class="wm-faq__icon" viewbox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2"><path d="M6 9l6 6 6-6"></path></svg>
        </button>
        <div class="wm-faq__panel">
          <div class="wm-faq__content">
            <p>Yes, surveys can be tailored at multiple levels, including by the instructor. Questions can be tailored to align with institutional priorities, teaching models, program requirements, or accreditation standards.</p>
          </div>
        </div>
      </div>

        <div class="wm-faq__item">
        <button class="wm-faq__trigger">
          <span class="wm-faq__question">How will CE&S improve survey response rates?</span>
          <svg class="wm-faq__icon" viewbox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2"><path d="M6 9l6 6 6-6"></path></svg>
        </button>
        <div class="wm-faq__panel">
          <div class="wm-faq__content">
            <p>First and foremost by putting surveys right where students are learning – inside their LMS. With automated reminders and prompts to drive participation. Other key response rate drivers include transparent response rate tracking for administrators and instructors, automated email programs, and SMS outreach options that can be used together to reach students at the right time and place for them.</p>
          </div>
        </div>
      </div>

        <div class="wm-faq__item">
        <button class="wm-faq__trigger">
          <span class="wm-faq__question">Can course evaluation data be used for faculty review?</span>
          <svg class="wm-faq__icon" viewbox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2"><path d="M6 9l6 6 6-6"></path></svg>
        </button>
        <div class="wm-faq__panel">
          <div class="wm-faq__content">
            <p>Yes. Institutions often use aggregated and structured evaluation data to support faculty annual reviews, promotion processes, and teaching effectiveness documentation. CE&S is often integrated with <a href="https://www.watermarkinsights.com/resources/flyer/watermark-course-evaluations-surveys-faculty-success/">Faculty Success</a> to streamline this further.</p>
          </div>
        </div>
      </div>

        <div class="wm-faq__item">
        <button class="wm-faq__trigger">
          <span class="wm-faq__question">How are course evaluations used for accreditation?</span>
          <svg class="wm-faq__icon" viewbox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2"><path d="M6 9l6 6 6-6"></path></svg>
        </button>
        <div class="wm-faq__panel">
          <div class="wm-faq__content">
            <p>Course evaluation data provides evidence of teaching effectiveness and student experience, which can be used in accreditation reports and institutional effectiveness documentation.</p>
          </div>
        </div>
      </div>

  <div class="wm-faq__item">
        <button class="wm-faq__trigger">
          <span class="wm-faq__question">How do Watermark Course Evaluations & Surveys and Faculty Success work together?</span>
          <svg class="wm-faq__icon" viewbox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2"><path d="M6 9l6 6 6-6"></path></svg>
        </button>
        <div class="wm-faq__panel">
          <div class="wm-faq__content">
            <p>Watermark Course Evaluations & Surveys connects directly with Watermark Faculty Success. Once an evaluation project is complete, an authorized administrator can sync evaluation reports to the corresponding Scheduled Teaching records in Faculty Success. This gives instructors access to student feedback alongside their course and faculty activity information.</p>
          </div>
        </div>
      </div>
   <div class="wm-faq__item">
        <button class="wm-faq__trigger">
          <span class="wm-faq__question">Do faculty have to manually export and import course evaluation results?</span>
          <svg class="wm-faq__icon" viewbox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2"><path d="M6 9l6 6 6-6"></path></svg>
        </button>
        <div class="wm-faq__panel">
          <div class="wm-faq__content">
            <p>No. Faculty do not need to download spreadsheets, upload evaluation results or re-enter the data in Faculty Success. Once the integration is configured, an administrator initiates the sync and the software automatically matches the evaluation reports with the appropriate teaching records.</p>
          </div>
        </div>
      </div>

  <div class="wm-faq__item">
        <button class="wm-faq__trigger">
          <span class="wm-faq__question">Can course evaluation results be included in faculty review materials?</span>
          <svg class="wm-faq__icon" viewbox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2"><path d="M6 9l6 6 6-6"></path></svg>
        </button>
        <div class="wm-faq__panel">
          <div class="wm-faq__content">
            <p>Yes. Course evaluation reports synced from CES can be accessed through Faculty Success and included as links within configured Faculty Success reports. This allows institutions to incorporate student feedback into annual review, promotion and tenure, and faculty development processes while maintaining appropriate permissions. <a href="https://support.watermarkinsights.com/hc/en-us/articles/37600378650139-How-to-Include-CES-Reports-in-your-Faculty-Success-Reports?utm_source=chatgpt.com">Including CES reports in Faculty Success reports</a>
</p>
          </div>
        </div>
      </div>

  <div class="wm-faq__item">
        <button class="wm-faq__trigger">
          <span class="wm-faq__question">Is Watermark one platform or two separate platforms?</span>
          <svg class="wm-faq__icon" viewbox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2"><path d="M6 9l6 6 6-6"></path></svg>
        </button>
        <div class="wm-faq__panel">
          <div class="wm-faq__content">
            <p>Course Evaluations & Surveys and Faculty Success are purpose-built Watermark solutions that can be used independently or connected. When used together, they provide a connected workflow from collecting student feedback to making evaluation reports available with faculty teaching and activity records. This gives institutions specialized capabilities without requiring faculty to move data manually between systems.
</p>
          </div>
        </div>
      </div>

 <div class="wm-faq__item">
        <button class="wm-faq__trigger">
          <span class="wm-faq__question">How does Faculty Success reduce manual data entry for faculty?</span>
          <svg class="wm-faq__icon" viewbox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2"><path d="M6 9l6 6 6-6"></path></svg>
        </button>
        <div class="wm-faq__panel">
          <div class="wm-faq__content">
            <p>Faculty Success offers several ways to quickly build and maintain a faculty profile. Faculty can use AI-powered CV imports, connect to sources including ORCID, Scopus, PubMed and Crossref, import citation files, or review publications identified through proactive searches. Faculty can then verify and supplement the information rather than entering every activity manually. <a href="https://www.watermarkinsights.com/solutions/faculty-success">Faculty Success product page</a>

</p>
          </div>
        </div>
      </div>

 <div class="wm-faq__item">
        <button class="wm-faq__trigger">
          <span class="wm-faq__question">Can I send survey notifications by text message?</span>
          <svg class="wm-faq__icon" viewbox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2"><path d="M6 9l6 6 6-6"></path></svg>
        </button>
        <div class="wm-faq__panel">
          <div class="wm-faq__content">
            <p>Yes. <a href="https://www.watermarkinsights.com/resources/flyer/watermark-course-evaluations-and-surveys-text-messaging/"> Text messaging</a> is available as an add-on for institutions in the US, giving administrators a third way to reach students alongside email and LMS notifications. It works the same way you already schedule email communications, with automatic opt-out and consent tracking built in to meet TCPA requirements. Ask your Watermark representative to add it to your agreement.
</p>
          </div>
        </div>
      </div>

      </div>
  </div>
</section>

<script>
(function () {
  var track     = document.getElementById('eucTrack');
  var btnPrev   = document.getElementById('eucPrev');
  var btnNext   = document.getElementById('eucNext');
  var section   = track.closest('.euc-section') || track.parentNode.parentNode.parentNode;

  var cards     = track.querySelectorAll('.euc-card');
  var total     = cards.length;
  var visible   = window.innerWidth <= 768 ? 1 : 3;
  var current   = 0;
  var isTransitioning = false; // Bloqueo para evitar clics dobles durante la animación
  var autoTimer = null;
  var INTERVAL  = 3000; 

  // --- 1. PREPARACIÓN PARA LOOP INFINITO ---
  // Clonamos los primeros 'visible' elementos y los añadimos al final
  for (var i = 0; i < visible; i++) {
    var clone = cards[i].cloneNode(true);
    track.appendChild(clone);
  }

  function getCardWidth() {
    var w = cards[0].offsetWidth;
    if (!w) w = cards[0].getBoundingClientRect().width;
    return w + 24; // Ancho + Gap
  }

  function update(animate = true) {
    if (!animate) track.style.transition = 'none';
    var offset = current * getCardWidth();
    track.style.transform = 'translateX(-' + offset + 'px)';
    
    if (!animate) {
      // Forzamos un reflow para que el navegador procese el cambio sin transición
      track.offsetHeight; 
      track.style.transition = '';
    }
  }

  function next() {
    if (isTransitioning) return;
    current++;
    track.style.transition = 'transform 0.5s ease-in-out'; // Aseguramos que haya transición
    update(true);

    // --- 2. EL TRUCO DEL INFINITO ---
    // Si llegamos al índice que es igual al total original (donde empiezan los clones)
    if (current === total) {
      isTransitioning = true;
      setTimeout(function() {
        track.style.transition = 'none'; // Quitamos animación
        current = 0; // Volvemos al inicio real
        update(false);
        isTransitioning = false;
      }, 500); // Este tiempo debe coincidir con la duración de tu CSS transition
    }
  }

  function prev() {
    if (isTransitioning) return;
    if (current === 0) {
      // Si estamos al inicio y queremos ir atrás, saltamos al clon sin que se note
      track.style.transition = 'none';
      current = total;
      update(false);
      // Pequeño delay para que el salto sin animación ocurra antes de la animación a current-1
      setTimeout(function() {
        current--;
        track.style.transition = 'transform 0.5s ease-in-out';
        update(true);
      }, 10);
    } else {
      current--;
      update(true);
    }
  }

  // Eventos
  btnNext.addEventListener('click', function () {
    stopAutoplay();
    next();
    startAutoplay();
  });

  btnPrev.addEventListener('click', function () {
    stopAutoplay();
    prev();
    startAutoplay();
  });

  function startAutoplay() {
    stopAutoplay();
    autoTimer = setInterval(next, INTERVAL);
  }

  function stopAutoplay() {
    if (autoTimer) { clearInterval(autoTimer); autoTimer = null; }
  }

  section.addEventListener('mouseenter', stopAutoplay);
  section.addEventListener('mouseleave', startAutoplay);

  window.addEventListener('resize', function () {
    visible = window.innerWidth <= 768 ? 1 : 3;
    update(false);
  });

  window.addEventListener('load', function () {
    update(false);
    startAutoplay();
  });

  if (document.readyState === 'complete') {
    update(false);
    startAutoplay();
  }

  function updateCounter() {
  var display = (current % total) + 1;
  document.getElementById('eucCounter').textContent = display + ' of ' + total;
}

function update(animate) {
  if (animate === false) track.style.transition = 'none';
  var offset = current * getCardWidth();
  track.style.transform = 'translateX(-' + offset + 'px)';
  
  if (animate === false) {
    track.offsetHeight;
    track.style.transition = '';
  }
  updateCounter(); //
}
})();
</script>

        </button>
        <div class="wm-faq__panel">
          <div class="wm-faq__content">
           <p>Watermark Course Evaluations & Surveys is a centralized platform for collecting, managing, and analyzing feedback from students and stakeholders about courses, instructors, and academic programs. It enables institutions to standardize evaluation processes and use feedback to improve teaching and learning.</p>
          </div>
        </div>
      </div>

      <div class="wm-faq__item">
        <button class="wm-faq__trigger">
          <span class="wm-faq__question">I already have a survey tool. What are the benefits of switching?</span>
          <svg class="wm-faq__icon" viewbox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2"><path d="M6 9l6 6 6-6"></path></svg>
        </button>
        <div class="wm-faq__panel">
          <div class="wm-faq__content">
            <p>More than 30 institutions made the switch from their prior vendor to Watermark Course Evaluations & Surveys in the last six months alone. This year, a dozen switched from Blackboard (formerly Anthology), half a dozen from Explorance, and more than half a dozen from Scantron — plus a dozen institutions that moved from generic survey tools to a platform built specifically for student feedback. We make switching seamless, and our work is backed by numerous awards, including the 2026 EdTech Breakthrough Award for Best Course Evaluation Solution. <a href="https://www.watermarkinsights.com/resources/flyer/what-sets-course-evaluations-and-surveys-apart/">See what sets us apart.</a></p>
          </div>
        </div>
      </div>

      <div class="wm-faq__item">
        <button class="wm-faq__trigger">
          <span class="wm-faq__question">Who uses CE&S?</span>
          <svg class="wm-faq__icon" viewbox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2"><path d="M6 9l6 6 6-6"></path></svg>
        </button>
        <div class="wm-faq__panel">
          <div class="wm-faq__content">
            <p>The platform is used by institutional effectiveness and institutional research offices, teaching and learning centers, academic leadership, department chairs, and faculty members involved in evaluation, assessment, and instructional improvement. Students are the most essential user, participating in the surveys that drive all the data.</p>
          </div>
        </div>
      </div>

      <div class="wm-faq__item">
        <button class="wm-faq__trigger">
          <span class="wm-faq__question">What challenges does CE&S help solve?</span>
          <svg class="wm-faq__icon" viewbox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2"><path d="M6 9l6 6 6-6"></path></svg>
        </button>
        <div class="wm-faq__panel">
          <div class="wm-faq__content">
            <p>It helps institutions address low survey response rates, inconsistent evaluation processes, fragmented survey tools, limited reporting capabilities, and difficulty connecting feedback to actionable improvements.</p>
          </div>
        </div>
      </div>

      <div class="wm-faq__item">
        <button class="wm-faq__trigger">
          <span class="wm-faq__question">How does CE&S help institutions collect course feedback?</span>
          <svg class="wm-faq__icon" viewbox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2"><path d="M6 9l6 6 6-6"></path></svg>
        </button>
        <div class="wm-faq__panel">
          <div class="wm-faq__content">
            <p>The platform enables institutions to deploy standardized or customized surveys, collect responses from students, and ensure consistent evaluation processes across departments and programs.</p>
          </div>
        </div>
      </div>

      <div class="wm-faq__item">
        <button class="wm-faq__trigger">
          <span class="wm-faq__question">Can I customize course evaluation surveys?</span>
          <svg class="wm-faq__icon" viewbox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2"><path d="M6 9l6 6 6-6"></path></svg>
        </button>
        <div class="wm-faq__panel">
          <div class="wm-faq__content">
            <p>Yes, surveys can be tailored at multiple levels, including by the instructor. Questions can be tailored to align with institutional priorities, teaching models, program requirements, or accreditation standards.</p>
          </div>
        </div>
      </div>

        <div class="wm-faq__item">
        <button class="wm-faq__trigger">
          <span class="wm-faq__question">How will CE&S improve survey response rates?</span>
          <svg class="wm-faq__icon" viewbox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2"><path d="M6 9l6 6 6-6"></path></svg>
        </button>
        <div class="wm-faq__panel">
          <div class="wm-faq__content">
            <p>First and foremost by putting surveys right where students are learning – inside their LMS. With automated reminders and prompts to drive participation. Other key response rate drivers include transparent response rate tracking for administrators and instructors, automated email programs, and SMS outreach options that can be used together to reach students at the right time and place for them.</p>
          </div>
        </div>
      </div>

        <div class="wm-faq__item">
        <button class="wm-faq__trigger">
          <span class="wm-faq__question">Can course evaluation data be used for faculty review?</span>
          <svg class="wm-faq__icon" viewbox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2"><path d="M6 9l6 6 6-6"></path></svg>
        </button>
        <div class="wm-faq__panel">
          <div class="wm-faq__content">
            <p>Yes. Institutions often use aggregated and structured evaluation data to support faculty annual reviews, promotion processes, and teaching effectiveness documentation. CE&S is often integrated with <a href="https://www.watermarkinsights.com/resources/flyer/watermark-course-evaluations-surveys-faculty-success/">Faculty Success</a> to streamline this further.</p>
          </div>
        </div>
      </div>

        <div class="wm-faq__item">
        <button class="wm-faq__trigger">
          <span class="wm-faq__question">How are course evaluations used for accreditation?</span>
          <svg class="wm-faq__icon" viewbox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2"><path d="M6 9l6 6 6-6"></path></svg>
        </button>
        <div class="wm-faq__panel">
          <div class="wm-faq__content">
            <p>Course evaluation data provides evidence of teaching effectiveness and student experience, which can be used in accreditation reports and institutional effectiveness documentation.</p>
          </div>
        </div>
      </div>

  <div class="wm-faq__item">
        <button class="wm-faq__trigger">
          <span class="wm-faq__question">How do Watermark Course Evaluations & Surveys and Faculty Success work together?</span>
          <svg class="wm-faq__icon" viewbox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2"><path d="M6 9l6 6 6-6"></path></svg>
        </button>
        <div class="wm-faq__panel">
          <div class="wm-faq__content">

Once an evaluation project is complete, an authorized administrator can sync evaluation reports to the corresponding Scheduled Teaching records in Faculty Success. This gives instructors access to student feedback alongside their course and faculty activity information.</p>
          </div>
        </div>
      </div>
   <div class="wm-faq__item">

          <span class="wm-faq__question">Do faculty have to manually export and import course evaluation results?</span>

</p>
          </div>
        </div>
      </div>

  <div class="wm-faq__item">

</p>
          </div>
        </div>
      </div>

 <div class="wm-faq__item">

</p>
