<script>
(function () {
  var track     = document.getElementById('eucTrack');
  var btnPrev   = document.getElementById('eucPrev');
  var btnNext   = document.getElementById('eucNext');
  var section   = track.closest('.euc-section') || track.parentNode.parentNode.parentNode;

  var cards     = track.querySelectorAll('.euc-card');
  var total     = cards.length;
  var visible   = window.innerWidth <= 768 ? 1 : 3;
  var current   = 0;
  var isTransitioning = false; // Bloqueo para evitar clics dobles durante la animación
  var autoTimer = null;
  var INTERVAL  = 3000; 

  // --- 1. PREPARACIÓN PARA LOOP INFINITO ---
  // Clonamos los primeros 'visible' elementos y los añadimos al final
  for (var i = 0; i < visible; i++) {
    var clone = cards[i].cloneNode(true);
    track.appendChild(clone);
  }

  function getCardWidth() {
    var w = cards[0].offsetWidth;
    if (!w) w = cards[0].getBoundingClientRect().width;
    return w + 24; // Ancho + Gap
  }

  function update(animate = true) {
    if (!animate) track.style.transition = 'none';
    var offset = current * getCardWidth();
    track.style.transform = 'translateX(-' + offset + 'px)';
    
    if (!animate) {
      // Forzamos un reflow para que el navegador procese el cambio sin transición
      track.offsetHeight; 
      track.style.transition = '';
    }
  }

  function next() {
    if (isTransitioning) return;
    current++;
    track.style.transition = 'transform 0.5s ease-in-out'; // Aseguramos que haya transición
    update(true);

    // --- 2. EL TRUCO DEL INFINITO ---
    // Si llegamos al índice que es igual al total original (donde empiezan los clones)
    if (current === total) {
      isTransitioning = true;
      setTimeout(function() {
        track.style.transition = 'none'; // Quitamos animación
        current = 0; // Volvemos al inicio real
        update(false);
        isTransitioning = false;
      }, 500); // Este tiempo debe coincidir con la duración de tu CSS transition
    }
  }

  function prev() {
    if (isTransitioning) return;
    if (current === 0) {
      // Si estamos al inicio y queremos ir atrás, saltamos al clon sin que se note
      track.style.transition = 'none';
      current = total;
      update(false);
      // Pequeño delay para que el salto sin animación ocurra antes de la animación a current-1
      setTimeout(function() {
        current--;
        track.style.transition = 'transform 0.5s ease-in-out';
        update(true);
      }, 10);
    } else {
      current--;
      update(true);
    }
  }

  // Eventos
  btnNext.addEventListener('click', function () {
    stopAutoplay();
    next();
    startAutoplay();
  });

  btnPrev.addEventListener('click', function () {
    stopAutoplay();
    prev();
    startAutoplay();
  });

  function startAutoplay() {
    stopAutoplay();
    autoTimer = setInterval(next, INTERVAL);
  }

  function stopAutoplay() {
    if (autoTimer) { clearInterval(autoTimer); autoTimer = null; }
  }

  section.addEventListener('mouseenter', stopAutoplay);
  section.addEventListener('mouseleave', startAutoplay);

  window.addEventListener('resize', function () {
    visible = window.innerWidth <= 768 ? 1 : 3;
    update(false);
  });

  window.addEventListener('load', function () {
    update(false);
    startAutoplay();
  });

  if (document.readyState === 'complete') {
    update(false);
    startAutoplay();
  }

  function updateCounter() {
  var display = (current % total) + 1;
  document.getElementById('eucCounter').textContent = display + ' of ' + total;
}

function update(animate) {
  if (animate === false) track.style.transition = 'none';
  var offset = current * getCardWidth();
  track.style.transform = 'translateX(-' + offset + 'px)';
  
  if (animate === false) {
    track.offsetHeight;
    track.style.transition = '';
  }
  updateCounter(); //
}
})();
</script>

<section class="wm-faq" id="faqs">
  <div class="wm-faq__container">
    <h2 class="wm-faq__title">FAQs</h2>

    <div class="wm-faq__list">
      <div class="wm-faq__item wm-faq__item--active">
        <button class="wm-faq__trigger">
          <span class="wm-faq__question">What is Watermark Course Evaluations & Surveys (CE&S)?</span>
          <svg class="wm-faq__icon" viewbox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2"><path d="M6 9l6 6 6-6"></path></svg>
        </button>
        <div class="wm-faq__panel">
          <div class="wm-faq__content">
           <p>Watermark Course Evaluations & Surveys is a centralized platform for collecting, managing, and analyzing feedback from students and stakeholders about courses, instructors, and academic programs. It enables institutions to standardize evaluation processes and use feedback to improve teaching and learning.</p>
          </div>
        </div>
      </div>

      <div class="wm-faq__item">
        <button class="wm-faq__trigger">
          <span class="wm-faq__question">I already have a survey tool. What are the benefits of switching?</span>
          <svg class="wm-faq__icon" viewbox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2"><path d="M6 9l6 6 6-6"></path></svg>
        </button>
        <div class="wm-faq__panel">
          <div class="wm-faq__content">
            <p>More than 30 institutions made the switch from their prior vendor to Watermark Course Evaluations & Surveys in the last six months alone. This year, a dozen switched from Blackboard (formerly Anthology), half a dozen from Explorance, and more than half a dozen from Scantron — plus a dozen institutions that moved from generic survey tools to a platform built specifically for student feedback. We make switching seamless, and our work is backed by numerous awards, including the 2026 EdTech Breakthrough Award for Best Course Evaluation Solution. <a href="https://www.watermarkinsights.com/resources/flyer/what-sets-course-evaluations-and-surveys-apart/">See what sets us apart.</a></p>
          </div>
        </div>
      </div>

      <div class="wm-faq__item">
        <button class="wm-faq__trigger">
          <span class="wm-faq__question">Who uses CE&S?</span>
          <svg class="wm-faq__icon" viewbox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2"><path d="M6 9l6 6 6-6"></path></svg>
        </button>
        <div class="wm-faq__panel">
          <div class="wm-faq__content">
            <p>The platform is used by institutional effectiveness and institutional research offices, teaching and learning centers, academic leadership, department chairs, and faculty members involved in evaluation, assessment, and instructional improvement. Students are the most essential user, participating in the surveys that drive all the data.</p>
          </div>
        </div>
      </div>

      <div class="wm-faq__item">
        <button class="wm-faq__trigger">
          <span class="wm-faq__question">What challenges does CE&S help solve?</span>
          <svg class="wm-faq__icon" viewbox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2"><path d="M6 9l6 6 6-6"></path></svg>
        </button>
        <div class="wm-faq__panel">
          <div class="wm-faq__content">
            <p>It helps institutions address low survey response rates, inconsistent evaluation processes, fragmented survey tools, limited reporting capabilities, and difficulty connecting feedback to actionable improvements.</p>
          </div>
        </div>
      </div>

      <div class="wm-faq__item">
        <button class="wm-faq__trigger">
          <span class="wm-faq__question">How does CE&S help institutions collect course feedback?</span>
          <svg class="wm-faq__icon" viewbox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2"><path d="M6 9l6 6 6-6"></path></svg>
        </button>
        <div class="wm-faq__panel">
          <div class="wm-faq__content">
            <p>The platform enables institutions to deploy standardized or customized surveys, collect responses from students, and ensure consistent evaluation processes across departments and programs.</p>
          </div>
        </div>
      </div>

      <div class="wm-faq__item">
        <button class="wm-faq__trigger">
          <span class="wm-faq__question">Can I customize course evaluation surveys?</span>
          <svg class="wm-faq__icon" viewbox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2"><path d="M6 9l6 6 6-6"></path></svg>
        </button>
        <div class="wm-faq__panel">
          <div class="wm-faq__content">
            <p>Yes, surveys can be tailored at multiple levels, including by the instructor. Questions can be tailored to align with institutional priorities, teaching models, program requirements, or accreditation standards.</p>
          </div>
        </div>

  var btnPrev   = document.getElementById('eucPrev');
  var btnNext   = document.getElementById('eucNext');
  var section   = track.closest('.euc-section') || track.parentNode.parentNode.parentNode;

  var cards     = track.querySelectorAll('.euc-card');
  var total     = cards.length;
  var visible   = window.innerWidth <= 768 ? 1 : 3;
  var current   = 0;
  var isTransitioning = false; // Bloqueo para evitar clics dobles durante la animación
  var autoTimer = null;
  var INTERVAL  = 3000; 

  // --- 1. PREPARACIÓN PARA LOOP INFINITO ---
  // Clonamos los primeros 'visible' elementos y los añadimos al final
  for (var i = 0; i < visible; i++) {
    var clone = cards[i].cloneNode(true);
    track.appendChild(clone);
  }

  function getCardWidth() {
    var w = cards[0].offsetWidth;
    if (!w) w = cards[0].getBoundingClientRect().width;
    return w + 24; // Ancho + Gap
  }

  function update(animate = true) {
    if (!animate) track.style.transition = 'none';
    var offset = current * getCardWidth();
    track.style.transform = 'translateX(-' + offset + 'px)';
    
    if (!animate) {
      // Forzamos un reflow para que el navegador procese el cambio sin transición
      track.offsetHeight; 
      track.style.transition = '';
    }
  }

  function next() {
    if (isTransitioning) return;
    current++;
    track.style.transition = 'transform 0.5s ease-in-out'; // Aseguramos que haya transición
    update(true);

    // --- 2. EL TRUCO DEL INFINITO ---
    // Si llegamos al índice que es igual al total original (donde empiezan los clones)
    if (current === total) {
      isTransitioning = true;
      setTimeout(function() {
        track.style.transition = 'none'; // Quitamos animación
        current = 0; // Volvemos al inicio real
        update(false);
        isTransitioning = false;
      }, 500); // Este tiempo debe coincidir con la duración de tu CSS transition
    }
  }

  function prev() {
    if (isTransitioning) return;
    if (current === 0) {
      // Si estamos al inicio y queremos ir atrás, saltamos al clon sin que se note
      track.style.transition = 'none';
      current = total;
      update(false);
      // Pequeño delay para que el salto sin animación ocurra antes de la animación a current-1
      setTimeout(function() {
        current--;
        track.style.transition = 'transform 0.5s ease-in-out';
        update(true);
      }, 10);
    } else {
      current--;
      update(true);
    }
  }

  // Eventos
  btnNext.addEventListener('click', function () {
    stopAutoplay();
    next();
    startAutoplay();
  });

  btnPrev.addEventListener('click', function () {
    stopAutoplay();
    prev();
    startAutoplay();
  });

  function startAutoplay() {
    stopAutoplay();
    autoTimer = setInterval(next, INTERVAL);
  }

  function stopAutoplay() {
    if (autoTimer) { clearInterval(autoTimer); autoTimer = null; }
  }

  section.addEventListener('mouseenter', stopAutoplay);
  section.addEventListener('mouseleave', startAutoplay);

  window.addEventListener('resize', function () {
    visible = window.innerWidth <= 768 ? 1 : 3;
    update(false);
  });

  window.addEventListener('load', function () {
    update(false);
    startAutoplay();
  });

  if (document.readyState === 'complete') {
    update(false);
    startAutoplay();
  }

  function updateCounter() {
  var display = (current % total) + 1;
  document.getElementById('eucCounter').textContent = display + ' of ' + total;
}

function update(animate) {
  if (animate === false) track.style.transition = 'none';
  var offset = current * getCardWidth();
  track.style.transform = 'translateX(-' + offset + 'px)';
  
  if (animate === false) {
    track.offsetHeight;
    track.style.transition = '';
  }
  updateCounter(); //
}
})();
</script>
